The signed agreement sets the go-live date at December 7, 2026, provided Tradewell completes its onboarding obligations (KYC data and webhook certification) at least five business days beforehand [1]. If Quillon misses the date for reasons attributable to it, Tradewell gets a credit of 5% of monthly platform fees per full week of delay, capped at 25%, and this is its sole remedy for delay [1].

On ownership, Tomer Golan owns the Tradewell cutover end to end, including payout engine config, webhooks and the go/no-go checklist [2]. On Tradewell's side, Ellen is the owner [2].

Note that the webhook certification is still in progress, with recertification planned for November 24 [3].
